# Third-party headers

Single-file libraries the SDL2 host compiles in, so it needs nothing but SDL2
and the system's libcurl. Unmodified copies of upstream.

| File | From | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stb_truetype.h` | https://github.com/nothings/stb | MIT or public domain (see the end of the file) |
| `stb_image.h` | https://github.com/nothings/stb | MIT or public domain |
| `stb_image_write.h` | https://github.com/nothings/stb | MIT or public domain |
| `nanosvg.h`, `nanosvgrast.h` | https://github.com/memononen/nanosvg | zlib (`LICENSE.nanosvg`) |
